## Interactions & Behaviors

### Left Rail
- **Click smart list item:** Loads that list in center content area, updates URL to `/people/list/{id}`, highlights the item in the rail
- **Badge counts:** Update dynamically as contacts match/unmatch smart list criteria [INFERRED]
- **"Manage":** Routes to smart list management/edit page [INFERRED: `/smart-lists` or `/admin/smart-lists`]
- **Hover on smart list item:** Shows hover state (light background), possibly reveals edit/settings icon [INFERRED]

### Toolbar
- **"Edit" (next to "All Expiredds" heading):** Opens smart list name/criteria editor — likely an inline edit or modal [INFERRED]
- **Person-add icon:** Opens "Add contact" dialog or quick-add flow [INFERRED]
- **Export icon:** Downloads contacts as CSV or opens export modal [INFERRED]
- **Column icon:** Opens column selector (same as "Columns" dropdown) [INFERRED]
- **Sort icon:** Opens sort configuration [INFERRED]
- **"Columns" dropdown:** Opens a panel to show/hide/reorder columns in the table
- **"Out Of State Home …" dropdown:** Likely a saved view or segment switcher for pre-defined column/filter presets [INFERRED]
- **"Filters (7)" button:** Toggles the right filter panel open/closed; badge shows count of active filters
- **"Update List" button:** Triggers a recalculation/refresh of the smart list membership based on current criteria; blue filled = primary action
- **Blue square icon (right of "Update List"):** Likely "Save list settings" or "Share list" [INFERRED]

### Table
- **Click column header (Name, Created, Last Visit, etc.):** Sorts table by that column; toggles ascending/descending; active sort shown with arrow indicator
- **Click contact row:** Navigates to that contact's detail page (`/people/{id}`) [INFERRED]
- **Hover on row:** Reveals row-level actions (possibly Call, Email, SMS quick-action buttons appearing inline on right) [INFERRED from FUB patterns]
- **Click phone number:** Initiates call via FUB dialer [INFERRED]
- **Click communication preview (email text):** Expands or navigates to that email thread [INFERRED]
- **Pagination arrows `<` `>`:** Navigate between pages of the list

### Filter Panel
- **"Add a filter" input:** Type to search available filter fields; autocompletes a dropdown of filter options [INFERRED]
- **Click collapsed filter row:** Expands the filter to show its options/values; collapses others or allows multiple expanded
- **Click X on expanded filter header:** Collapses that filter back to collapsed state (not removes it)
- **Radio button selection (Phone is good → "is good"):** Changes the phone filter condition; selecting a radio immediately applies the filter [INFERRED] or requires a confirm action
- **Chevron on collapsed row:** Toggle expand/collapse of that filter's options
- **"Clear filters" button:** Removes ALL 7 active filters, resets to unfiltered list
- **Click outside panel or "Filters" button again:** Closes the filter panel [INFERRED]
- **Individual filter row — remove:** Likely a small X icon appears on hover of each filter row to remove just that one filter [INFERRED from FUB patterns]

### Smart List — "Update List" behavior
- FUB smart lists can be either "dynamic" (auto-updating) or "static" (fixed membership until manually updated)
- The presence of "Update List" button with a refresh icon suggests this list may be a static/manual-refresh smart list, where clicking the button recalculates membership based on the saved criteria [INFERRED]

```jsx
      <ColumnCountIndicator label="Showing 3 of 20" />
    </SmartListHeader>

    <SmartListToolbar>
      <InfoLink label="How Smart Lists work" />
      <ColumnsDropdown />
      <ViewPresetDropdown label="Out Of State Home …" />
      <FilterButton count={7} active={filterPanelOpen} onClick={toggleFilterPanel} />
      <UpdateListButton icon={RefreshIcon} label="Update List" variant="primary" />
      <SaveSettingsButton icon={BookmarkIcon} />
    </SmartListToolbar>

    <ContactTable
      columns={["name", "created", "last_visit", "last_communication", "last_text_received", "last_received_email", "phone"]}
      sortField="created"
      sortDir="desc"
    >
      <TableHeader>
        <SortableColumn field="name" label="Name" />
        <SortableColumn field="created" label="Created" sortDir="desc" active />
        <SortableColumn field="last_visit" label="Last Visit" />
        <SortableColumn field="last_communication" label="Last Communication" sortDir="asc" />
        <SortableColumn field="last_text_received" label="Last Text Received" />
        <SortableColumn field="last_received_email" label="Last Received Email" />
        <FilterableColumn field="phone" label="Phone" hasFilter />
      </TableHeader>

      <TableBody>
        {contacts.map(c => (
          <ContactRow key={c.id} contact={c}>
            <NameCell name={c.name} stageTag={c.stage} />
            <DateCell value={c.created_at} format="relative-then-absolute" />
            <DateCell value={c.last_visit} />
            <CommunicationCell value={c.last_communication_at} preview={c.last_comm_preview} icon={c.last_comm_type} />
            <DateCell value={c.last_text_received_at} />
            <DateCell value={c.last_received_email_at} />
            <PhoneCell phone={c.phone} quality={c.phone_quality} phoneType={c.phone_type} />
          </ContactRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </ContactTable>

    <Pagination currentPage={1} totalPages={N} />
  </ContentArea>

  {filterPanelOpen && (
    <FilterPanel>
      <FilterSearch placeholder="Add a filter" />
      <FilterList>
        <FilterRow
          icon="tag"
          label="Tags exclude any of"
          value="complianc…"
          collapsed
        />
        <FilterRow
          icon="clock"
          label="Last Communication more than"
          value="…"
          collapsed
        />
        <FilterRow
          icon="stage"
          label="Stage excludes any of"
          value="Active C…"
          collapsed
        />
        <FilterRow
          icon="phone"
          label="Phone is good"
          expanded
        >
          <RadioGroup value="is_good">
            <Radio value="is_good" label="is good" selected />
            <Radio value="starts_with" label="starts with" />
            <Radio value="is_not_empty" label="is not empty" />
            <Radio value="is_empty" label="is empty" />
            <Radio value="is_bad" label="is bad" />
          </RadioGroup>
        </FilterRow>
        <FilterRow
          icon="tag"
          label="Tags exclude any of"
          value="Unsubscri…"
          collapsed
        />
        <FilterRow
          icon="agent"
          label="Agent includes any of"
          value="Matt Ryan"
          collapsed
        />
        <FilterRow
          icon="tag"
          label="Tags include any of"
          value="Expired, wi…"
          collapsed
        />
      </FilterList>
      <ClearFiltersButton />
    </FilterPanel>
  )}
</PeoplePage>
```

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **Smart list count (457) vs page display:** The badge count in the left rail shows total list membership (457). The table shows a paginated subset. The "Showing 3 of 20" text in the toolbar likely refers to "3 columns visible of 20 available columns" — not contact count. Alternatively it could be a filtered subset count.

2. **Phone quality filter "is good" vs "is bad":** FUB assigns phone quality scores to numbers — "good" means verified/dialable, "bad" means invalid/disconnected. This is a key filter for expired listing outreach (you want to call people with good numbers). The Phone column's green circle icon visually confirms "good" status per row.

3. **Dual phone icons (green + blue circle):** The blue circle on some phone numbers likely indicates "cell phone" type vs "landline" — important for TCPA compliance (you can text cell phones, not landlines). Some contacts show both icons overlapping.

4. **"Update List" button semantics:** In FUB, smart lists can be "static" (frozen snapshot) or "dynamic" (auto-refreshes). The prominent "Update List" button with a refresh icon suggests this is a static smart list that must be manually refreshed to pick up new contacts matching the criteria. Dynamic lists wouldn't need this button.

5. **Filters (7) panel is a slide-in overlay**, not a modal. It renders over the table columns on the right side. The table scrolls independently under it. Clicking "Filters" again or clicking outside closes it.

6. **"Out Of State Home …" dropdown** in the toolbar is likely a "Saved View" or "Column Template" selector — a preset combination of columns and possibly filters optimized for a specific workflow (e.g., targeting out-of-state property owners). The truncation suggests a longer name.

7. **Filter expand behavior:** Only one filter is expanded at a time (the "Phone is good" filter is expanded, showing radio options). Clicking another collapsed filter row expands it and may collapse the currently expanded one (accordion-style) or may allow multiple expanded simultaneously [INFERRED].

8. **Stage label under name:** The stage shown below the contact name in the Name column (e.g., "Expired Listing", "Expired") is likely the FUB stage/pipeline stage, not just a tag. It appears in a lighter gray sub-label style.

9. **"All Expiredds" typo:** The smart list name has a double-d typo ("Expiredds"). This is the actual saved name (user-created). The Edit link beside the heading allows renaming.

10. **Filter "Tags include any of: Expired, wi…"** — The truncated value likely reads "Expired, Withdrawn" or "Expired, Withdrawn Listing" or similar — this is the inclusion tag filter that determines which contacts are in the expired listing bucket.

11. **Agent filter "includes any of: Matt Ryan"** — This scopes the list to only Matt Ryan's assigned contacts, filtering out Paul Stevenson's and Rebecca Peterson's contacts. Important in a multi-agent FUB instance.

12. **Date formatting:** FUB uses a mixed format — recent dates show as relative ("3 days", "6 days") while older dates show as absolute ("Nov 13th '25", "Dec 27th '25"). The threshold for switching from relative to absolute appears to be around 7-30 days.
